reason: DSHCode is primarily a cross-platform desktop interface for an extensible AI agent harness, combining chat, workflow orchestration, plugins, and local system tools.

summaries.zh: DSHCode 是一款适用于 macOS 和 Windows 的桌面 AI Agent 应用，提供对话界面、插件管理、工作流编排以及文件、终端和网页工具。
summaries.en: DSHCode is a macOS and Windows desktop AI agent application offering a conversational interface, plugin management, workflow orchestration, and file, terminal, and web tools.

capabilities: Runs a desktop Electron application on macOS and Windows
Provides an AI agent interface with bash, filesystem, terminal, web search/fetch, LSP, and subprocess tools
Supports plugin installation from npm or Git repositories
Uses DeepSeek models through an API key
Supports subagent delegation, workflows, plans, and persistent goals
Displays system notifications and starts a localhost HTTP service
